scenicChapters.title: Connecticut River Valley Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 8 km this is Connecticut River Valley Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

connecticut-river-valley-road.story: 44 km from Old Saybrook to Middletown, about 51 min of riding. On the way it passes Essex, Chester and East Haddam. The line favours views over speed.
